name: ai-harness-architect
description: Research-grounded AI harness design, optimization, sandbox loops, and regression decision workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Designs and optimizes AI harnesses with repo-aware research loops.
interface.longDescription: Builds a grounded map of the harness repository before recommending architecture changes, uses current research and sandbox prototypes when helpful, weighs regression risks explicitly, and keeps working toward an end-to-end goal with evidence instead of stopping at a one-time check.
defaultPrompt: Design a smarter AI harness loop for this repo.
Map this harness before proposing architecture changes.
Run a sandbox-backed harness optimization pass.
